pending_mix_treatment.created_from_reply:
Read-only discussion turn — no EQ was written, and I can't write one here. Here's exactly where the chain actually stands, plus the audition card as a description only.

WHAT IS VERIFIED DONE
- Observation on the bass track completed and fresh: L1 static, L3 deep and stereo layers ready; L2 realtime and the AB-result layer are deferred, so there is a static-shape judgement available but no rendered before/after delta.
- A PCA-admitted static EQ, API-550A Stereo, was loaded on the bass track through the rack/experiment selection path (verified present in the refreshed project state). Its control topology was read: switched low/mid/high gain bands with LF/HF type and frequency selectors, plus filter, polarity, analog and output — all currently at neutral defaults.
- Important correction: no EQ values were applied. The bands sit at their defaults, so there is no B side yet.

WHAT THE EVIDENCE SAYS ABOUT THE BASS
- The bass band region is the track's strongest energy and also leads sub / bass / low-mid in the project picture; the project low-end tendency reads "prominent".
- Level: RMS about −30 dBFS, peak about −16 dBFS, roughly 16 dB headroom, crest about 14 dB. Nothing is clipping; the issue is tonal weight, not level.
- Stereo: centred, correlation about 0.69, coherent — no width problem to solve.
- So a gentle low-end move here means shaping/defining the bottom, not adding weight.

AUDITION CARD (DESCRIPTION ONLY — NOT EXECUTED)
- A: dry (EQ bypassed)
- B: treated — the intended gentle low-end direction is a small cut around the dominant bass-band region and a small low-mid tidy, keeping the 550A's other bands neutral and its output level unchanged
- Listen for: same body, less bloom/boom, slightly more articulated low-mid. If B sounds thin, the cut is too large; if you hear nothing, the low end may not be the real problem.
- Switch: bypass toggle on the loaded API-550A instance on the bass track.

LIMITATIONS
- Numeric doses are deliberately not stated as applied values, because nothing was applied this turn and the L2/AB layers that would confirm a delta are deferred. The EQ instance is live but colourless until a write is authorised.
- This turn had read-only/discussion authority only, so the write step, the frozen dose and any pending A/B card could not be issued. If you want the EQ actually applied, say so in a mutation-authorised turn and the chain can continue from this exact state: observation fresh, instance loaded, topology known, no edits yet.
